P: Serve the mains when Dewey makes it big.
S: Cajun spiced peanuts boiled until soft, served warm in cones

Raw peanuts in the shell boiled for hours in a salty, spicy Cajun brine with chilli and garlic until soft, served warm in paper cones. Rinse 500g raw peanuts in the shell. Put in a large pot with 3L water, 80g salt, 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tbsp chilli flakes and 1 halved head of garlic. Weigh down with a plate so they stay under. Simmer 3 hours, topping up with water, until the nuts are soft like cooked beans. Leave in the brine 30 minutes more, then drain and serve warm in paper cones.
Fries under cheddar sauce. Edith: "I just know you're gonna fail."

Crisp shoestring fries smothered in melted cheddar sauce and spring onion, a diner basket from Dewey's early days on the road. Bake 1kg frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 250ml milk until thick, then 150g grated cheddar. Pour over the fries and scatter with sliced spring onion.
M: Buttermilk fried chicken with mashed potatoes and pepper gravy

Chicken pieces soaked in hot sauce buttermilk, fried crackling crisp, with creamy mashed potatoes and peppery cream gravy. Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces overnight in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt. Dredge in 250g plain flour mixed with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp pepper. Fry at 160C for 12 to 15 minutes until 75C inside. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. For gravy, whisk 2 tbsp frying oil with 2 tbsp flour, then 400ml milk, simmer until thick and season with lots of pepper.
the trip to India with the Beatles, where it all goes very colourful

Pumpkin, cauliflower and chickpea curry with coconut, spinach, basmati rice and mango chutney. Fry the chopped onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 6 minutes, then the curry paste for 1 minute. Add the diced pumpkin, cauliflower florets, chickpeas, coconut milk and 200ml water and simmer for 25 minutes until tender. Simmer the rice with 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5. Stir the spinach through the curry until wilted. Serve with the rice, mango chutney and coriander.
W: Mama Cox's sweet potato meringue pie
Spiced sweet potato pie with a toasted meringue top

Silky spiced sweet potato custard in a crisp pastry case, piled with a cloud of torched meringue and served with a spoon of cream. Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23cm tart tin with 1 shortcrust sheet and blind bake 15 minutes. Mash 500g cooked sweet potato with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs plus 2 yolks, 200ml evaporated milk, 1 tsp cinnamon and half a tsp nutmeg until smooth. Pour into the case and bake 40 minutes until just set. Cool. Whisk 2 egg whites with 100g caster sugar until glossy, pile on top and torch or grill until golden.
K: Dewey Cox Show peach sweet tea
Peach syrup black tea with lemon and mint over ice

Strong black tea brewed with ripe peach and brown sugar syrup, cooled and poured over plenty of ice with fresh peach slices, lemon and mint. Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 100g brown sugar and 100ml water for 10 minutes, then strain. Steep 5 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in the peach syrup. Chill 2 hours. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, add fresh peach slices and a lemon wedge, pour in the tea and top with mint.
